SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali mazoea timilifu. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: SARUFI 4.4.1 NYAKATI NA HALI MAZOEA TIMILIFU
This lesson teaches Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali mazoea timilifu for Grade 8 KISWAHILI.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali mazoea timilifu
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

2. Explain Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali mazoea timilifu to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali mazoea timilifu.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali mazoea timilifu with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali mazoea timilifu important for a Grade 8 learner?
